title: worth a shot
text: worth a shot. Honestly, I thought this was sort of a joke.  But in my continuous search for healthier food options, I love this.  I LOVE pasta.... while spiral cut zucchini isn't a "perfect" sub, it is totally acceptable to me. It takes about 5 minutes from start to finish, including quick cooking in a pan with a couple of drops of olive oil in a hot pan.  So in some ways it's faster than pasta. When you consider the calorie/carb load of pasta compared to the same of the spiral cut zucchini, you will be a believer too.  I have used it on raw carrots too.  Didn't think that would work, but it did.  Slightly different texture, obviously, but added some color too.  I would have to say that it's worth a try.
